title: Visitors confirm Kennedy-UFO connection
summary: Bryce Zable tells of Visitors confirm Kennedy-UFO connection, about 1996 at Dark Skies offices, Los Angeles, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

plain: Bryce Zable, a creator of Dark Skies, a 1990s TV drama about UFOs, told podcast host Jesse Michels that in 1996 visitors to the show's Los Angeles offices, including people he calls JC and the captain, told him parts of the show were right. He says they told him the link it drew between President John F. Kennedy and UFOs was "definitely" correct. If true, it would mean insiders were confirming that Kennedy's story was tied to UFO secrets.
